title: Inner product flip under a neighbor map
statement: Let $m>0$ and split a vector $z\in\mathbb F_2^{2m}$ into blocks $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^m$. Set $q=x_0y_0$, replace $x_0$ by $q+1$ and $y_0$ by $1$, and leave all other coordinates unchanged; the inner product modulo two of the resulting vector is the original inner product plus $1$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
